args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays. Affected versions: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed in
2.9.4. Bumping within the same major version (2.x) rather than jumping
to 3.1.0 to avoid a breaking major-version upgrade.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

## Details
- Affected ranges: `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed in **2.9.4** (per advisory).
- Chose 2.9.4 over 3.1.0 to stay within the same major version and avoid a breaking upgrade.
- Change is limited to `requirements.txt`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**.

Merging into main requires code owner approval, so alex is requested as reviewer.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
